description: One country's macro dashboard from Bullrun's Global Markets warehouse: a 0-100 macro stress score (higher = more stress) built from six pillars - labour (unemployment, its change, youth unemployment), housing (real house prices, price-to-income and price-to-rent vs history), credit (BIS credit-to-GDP gap, household debt service, household credit), fiscal (government debt, fiscal balance), external (current account) and cycle (GDP growth, inflation) - with every input's latest value, period, source (OECD, IMF, BIS, World Bank, Eurostat), its stress contribution and a historyCode for get_macro_history. Use for "how is the German economy doing", "is there a housing bubble in Canada", "macro risks in Italy", or to judge the backdrop for a country's stocks. A thinly covered country returns state "insufficient", never a falsely calm score. Read-only.

country.description: Country name, e.g. "Germany", "United States" (aliases like US, UK, Korea, Eurozone are understood). Also "Euro Area".
